paper.title_en: Couch-Torrence conformal inversion, supersymmetry and conserved charges for D3-branes
paper.abstract_en: An asymptotically flat spacetime in $D=4$ can be mapped via Couch-Torrence conformal inversion to the geometry around an extremal non-expanding and non-rotating horizon. At the linearized level, an infinite tower of conserved Newman-Penrose charges can be found at null-infinity, while infinitely many Aretakis charges are conserved in the near-horizon. Couch-Torrence inversion allows one to establish a matching between the two sets of asymptotic charges. In this work we construct the Newman-Penrose and Aretakis scalar charges in higher-dimensional geometries of D3-branes in $D=10$ and D3-brane bound states in $D=4$ and $D=5$ and establish a precise matching between them through the inversion. By exploiting the residual unbroken supersymmetry of Type IIB supergravity, we demonstrate that it is possible to relate scalar (complex dilaton) charges to higher spin charges. In particular, we determine infinite towers of conserved asymptotic spinorial charges associated with the dilatino fluctuations, and determine the map through inversion.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将Couch-Torrence共形反演推广到高维D3-brane几何，并在Type IIB超引力中建立Newman-Penrose荷与Aretakis荷的匹配，还利用残余超对称将标量荷与高自旋荷联系起来，理论深度和潜在启发性较强；摘要结构清晰，方法轮廓可辨，适合理论物理读者进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: D3-膜的Couch-Torrence共形反演、超对称与守恒荷
decision.abstract_zh: 在$D=4$中，渐近平坦时空可以通过Couch-Torrence共形反演映射到极端非膨胀、非旋转视界周围的几何。在线性化层面，可以在零无穷处找到无穷多的守恒Newman-Penrose荷，而在近视界处有无穷多个Aretakis荷守恒。Couch-Torrence反演允许人们建立两组渐近荷之间的匹配。在本工作中，我们在$D=10$的D3-膜和$D=4$、$D=5$的D3-膜束缚态的高维几何中构造Newman-Penrose和Aretakis标量荷，并通过反演在它们之间建立精确匹配。利用Type IIB超引力的残余未破缺超对称，我们证明有可能将标量（复伸缩子）荷与高自旋荷联系起来。特别地，我们确定了与dilatino涨落相关的无穷多个守恒渐近旋量荷，并确定了通过反演的映射。
